question: How does using eight independently qualified original recorded zeros change all-draw age-dependent panel support and conditional age/count/PPE moments relative to strict native missing-cell refusal?
base_protocol_scope: Reuse unchanged 32,000 saved joint ages, all 107 source owners, windows 3/4/5/9, five literal native/PPE pairings, fixed static 3 ha response, shared diagonal PPE covariance, conditional pooled-window count law, total covariance and fixed numerical criteria. No new fit, age realization, geometry calculation, PPE distribution or field calibration.
source_gate: Require the exact retained qualified result and independent 535-slot/527-reported/zero-disagreement/107-owner source check, all three external source identities, full depth bijection and exact eight owner/depth/row/column/native-taxon tuples. Every overlaid original token must be literal 0 and a valid integer zero; every native missing slot must be in that set. A changed proof, source identity, unmatched owner, blank, invalid or other value refuses the profile.
measurement_policy: Preserve every native omission, native panel mass and reported subtotal as native facts. A separate analytical panel uses only the eight original recorded zeros. All 527 reported native integers and all reported/omitted count masses remain unchanged. This is source-supported measurement context, not a general missing-to-zero rule, imputation, biological absence or independently measured replication.
support_policy: All 107 five-axis analytical panels have source support; do not restrict to the old 99 native-complete samples. Empty native windows and nonempty zero-mass panels still refuse. Preserve every seed/native-row identity and per-bin status over all 32,000 saved rows. Primary unconditional moments refuse any undefined mass; conditional moments name C_source explicitly.
population_comparison: Reconstruct the original strict native memberships from unchanged raw observations for every saved age row and compare every status/member/count-support field plus identity to the frozen original ledger. Require C_native to be a subset of C_source. Accumulate source-profile moments on exactly C_native and reproduce the old independently qualified mean, all six covariance components, gradients, spreads and 30 contrasts within absolute 1e-12, relative zero. Separately compare C_source and C_native probabilities and conditional moments; their difference reflects changed conditioning populations, not changed measurements within C_native.

rights_and_correspondence.original: Giesecke, Thomas (2010), EPD/PANGAEA doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.738429, CC BY-NC 3.0 Unported. The analytical use of its eight recorded zeros is local noncommercial research with attribution, separately from the Neotoma CC BY 4.0 release; no relicensing or broad commercial authority.
rights_and_correspondence.native: Neotoma dataset 19913, site 13338, collection unit 14910, ABBO, European Pollen Database, doi:10.21233/2vzb-bg61, Giesecke; all original/native source bytes stay external and unchanged.
rights_and_correspondence.morphology: Preserve original Betula, Cyperaceae, Juniperus-type, Pinus diploxylon-type and Gramineae comments alongside native Betula/Cyperaceae/Juniperus communis/Pinus sylvestris/Poaceae labels. Literal parameter transfer is the unchanged declared assumption, not new species/morphotype equivalence or taxonomic review.
rights_and_correspondence.physical_identity: Exact scaled original-metre/native-depth bijection and 527 count equalities support exported-series correspondence; native depth units, aliquot/core independence and historical LandClim selection are not thereby established.
rights_and_correspondence.publication: No original count matrix, table, age matrix or attachment is copied or redistributed. New full analytical outputs and support ledger remain local artifacts; any later compact factual scientific account must retain these terms and all conditional/source limits.
